description: This file defines React components for a callout UI element with different tones (info, caution, critical, positive) and a toolbar for changing tone and removing the callout. It uses various UI component libraries from '@keystar/ui' and integrates icons, styles, and accessibility features.

methods.name: Callout
methods.description: React component rendering a styled callout box with an icon, customizable tone, and children content.

methods.name: CalloutToolbar
methods.description: React component providing a toolbar to change the tone of the callout and remove it, illustrated with icons and tooltips.
